name: tia_list_plug_locations
description: List free plug locations (HardwareObject.GetPlugLocations: position number and label) and plugged items of a device or one device item. Without item_path, every hardware object of the device that has free positions is listed (racks, GSD heads with free submodule slots).

device_name.description: Exact device (station) name as listed by tia_list_devices, e.g. 'PLC_1' or 'ACS480_1'.

item_path.description: Slash-separated device-item path below the device, e.g. 'PLC_1/PROFINET interface_1' or 'Rail_0'. A single unique item name also works. Omit for the device itself.
